email.body1:
Kristin, saw PandaDoc named Keith Rabkin CEO and is lining up major automation and AI workflow launches for 2026.

A new chapter like that usually means more in-market accounts than the new-business team can route and act on before signals go stale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for PandaDoc off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kristin, quick follow-up for PandaDoc.

For new-business RevOps, the real drag is latency: signals fire, but nobody touches them fast enough, so pipeline that should convert decays in the queue. That gap usually shows up late, after a quarter is already at risk.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Kristin, last bit of proof for PandaDoc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PandaDoc's reply rate likely compares to other SaaS new-business teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kristin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling new-business pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A leadership transition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to PandaDoc either way.
